notes: Polish + UI uplift across the app. Profile is cleaner and grouped, with a tap-to-change logo. Set-up and Min/Max now block an invalid Min-over-Max before you send. Bigger, easier-tap buttons on Check-in/out, Min/Max and Find-a-part. A failed message keeps your typed text and tells you. Clearer empty and loading states everywhere, friendlier Messages list, and lots of accessibility + visual refinements. (Shows your company name + version on Profile.)
